results.content: Love the whimsy of Capybara Court but need other ways to settle spats? Try Purpur, a therapy game-app that sparks honest talks, or Maia, an AI coach for couples with tips and date ideas. Keep agreements clear with Handshake, handle hosting disputes via HostDispute, or make it playful with challenges on Kutt.
